text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While we're training in preparation for
the
Hopeful Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uphill...
choice_data_list: 『ホープフルS』では2度、坂を上る
choice_data_list_en: You climb the hill twice in the 'Hopeful Stakes'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Hopeful Stakes is a 2,000-meter
turf race
held at Nakayama Racecourse.
The starting line is
on a straight right
before a slope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Runners have to climb the same slope
twice, right
after the start and just
before the finish, a
challenge for
inexperienced junior racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll have a better chance if she focuses
on the
second pass, during her last
spurt, rather than the
initial jostling for
position.
choice_data_list: 1度目は坂での感覚を覚えて
choice_data_list_en: On the first run, get a feel for the slope.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Get a feel for it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh, meaning what, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: My stride?
choice_data_list: 坂を上る時の歩幅を把握するんだ
坂を上る時の歩幅を把握するんだよ
choice_data_list_en: Make sure you know your stride length when running uphill.
Make sure you know your stride length when running uphill, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come up with a strategy for the
Hopeful
Stakes, but I'm having trouble
explaining it
clearly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Which part? Uhh...
choice_data_list: どこがわかりづらかった？
choice_data_list_en: What part was hard to follow?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like... all of it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm just, you know... not, like, great with

strategies...
choice_data_list: なるほど……！
choice_data_list_en: I see...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, I get that much. I might be dumb, but I'm not that dumb.
choice_data_list: 2回坂を上るのはわかる？
choice_data_list_en: You know you'll be climbing the hill twice, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A test run?
choice_data_list: じゃあ1度目の坂はお試しとかだと？
choice_data_list_en: So the first hill is just to test the waters?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take her to a riverside slope to show
her what I
mean.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uhh, sure, I guess...
choice_data_list: いつもより大き目の歩幅で上ってみて
choice_data_list_en: Try climbing with longer strides than usual.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Well?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. You should've warned me I
was
gonna have to do it twice.
choice_data_list: 次は細かく、タタタタのリズムで
choice_data_list_en: Next, keep it quick, to a rat-a-tat rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her complaining, Tosen Jordan
makes a
spirited dash up the hill.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It felt easier than the first time, I
think?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah? Huh.
choice_data_list: 歩幅を狭くした方が坂は上りやすいんだ
歩幅を狭くした方が坂は上りやすいんだよ
choice_data_list_en: It's easier to climb a hill with shorter strides.
It's easier to climb a hill with shorter strides, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks surprised, but she already
does it
unconsciously on the training
course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's just that on unfamiliar terrain, like
this slope
by the river, she has no way of
knowing how to
adjust her stride
beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Because the hill at Nakayama and the
one at
school are different?
choice_data_list: レース本番もそうなると思う
choice_data_list_en: I think that's how it'll go in the actual race, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Different inclines require different
strides. The
only way to figure out the
best approach is to
actually run it.
choice_data_list: そう、だからお試しするんだ！
そう、だからお試しするんだよ！
choice_data_list_en: Right, that's why we're testing it out!
Right, that's why you have to try it out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Hopeful Stakes is here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So the first time up the slope is the test
run.
That's where I figure out the best
way to run up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then, when I go up the second
time—when it
really counts—I book it!
That about right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Got it! That's what I'll do!
choice_data_list: そういうこと！！
choice_data_list_en: That's it!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I've gotta take first if I wanna
make it
big.
choice_data_list: 気合いも入ったな
気合いも入ったね
choice_data_list_en: That got you fired up, too.
That got you fired up, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the Classic Triple Crown is a
must, which
means I've gotta deal with
the Satsuki next, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what are you shouting for? Trying
to blow
my ears out or something?
choice_data_list: 次の目標も決めてたんだな！！
次の目標も決めてたんだね！！
choice_data_list_en: You've already decided on your next goal too, huh?!
You've already decided on your next goal too, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As far as I knew, she never had any goal
besides
"making it big."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For her to name the Classic Triple Crown

specifically like that, she must have
been doing
some research.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ahhh!
choice_data_list: ……自分でも勉強してたんだな
……自分でも勉強してたんだね
choice_data_list_en: ...So you've been studying on your own, too.
...So you've been studying on your own, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whatever! First things first, I have the
Hopeful to
win, so see ya!
